name: WEBTOON 繁體中文（公開網頁）

provenance.implementation: Independently written public HTML scraper and official public episode API consumer; no upstream code or comic images copied.
provenance.scope: Public Traditional Chinese Originals web chapters only. Official app-only, paid, login/age gates and MotionToon are not bypassed; inaccessible chapters fail explicitly. Episode catalog uses the public mobile API with bounded cursor pagination.
provenance.networkEvidence: Listing, search and first chapter-list page observed. Viewer was unavailable during development (server-stopped HTML/TLS EOF); real viewer/image smoke remains required.
